description: Paid ($0.10 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, or in USD₮0 on X Layer): the trade setup for one crypto pair on three horizons at once: short term (1h candles), medium (4h) and long term (1d). Per horizon the six-indicator confluence signal (bias: long, short or none, with confidence) and, when the risk/reward to target 1 is at least 1.5, a plan (entry, stop, two take profit targets, risk/reward); otherwise the reason there is none. Plus alignment: how many horizons point the same way ("3 of 3 horizons short; a setup on 1 of 3"). Same as GET /setup/{pair}. Top-200 coins and XRPL DEX pairs. Not trade advice: in our backtest these setups did no better than random entries after fees. For the ranked list across all coins use trade_setups. Invalid pairs are rejected before payment.

pair.description: Crypto pair, e.g. BTC-USDT, SOL-USDT, TAO-USDT or ETHUSDT (Binance.US, then Kraken, Gate and MEXC: covers the top 200 coins). For the XRP Ledger DEX: xrpl:XRP-RLUSD, xrpl:SOLO-XRP, or with the issuer, xrpl:SOLO.rsoLo2S1kiGeCcn6hCUXVrCpGMWLrRrLZz-XRP
